out_sql: ["SELECT AVG(explainability_score) AS average_explainability_score \nFROM creative_ai \nWHERE region = 'Europe' OR region = 'North America';"]
["SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_accidents \n    FROM Accidents \n    WHERE launch_provider = 'SpaceX' OR launch_provider = 'Blue Origin';"]

['SELECT plant_name, SUM(co2_emission_per_ton_produced) AS total_co2_emission
FROM co2_emissions 
GROUP BY plant_name
ORDER BY total_co2_emission DESC
LIMIT 2;']
["SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost \nFROM climate_communication \nWHERE end_date > 2010 AND location = 'Antarctica';"]
["SELECT AVG(publications) AS average_publications\nFROM researchers\nWHERE organization = 'National Geographic';"]
["SELECT MAX(response_time) AS max_response_time\nFROM emergency_calls\nWHERE city = 'Los Angeles';"]
['SELECT country, AVG(military_personnel) AS average_military_personnel_per_country\nFROM Peacekeeping_Operations\nGROUP BY country;']

['SELECT
    client_id,
    MAX(investment) AS max_daily_investment
FROM daily_investments
GROUP BY client_id;']

["SELECT p.PortName, SUM(ch.Weight) AS TotalWeight
FROM PORTS p
JOIN CARGO_HANDLING ch ON p.ID = ch.PortID AND ch.CargoType = 'Fruit'
GROUP BY p.PortName;"]

['SELECT container_type, MIN(fuel_consumption) AS min_fuel
FROM container_ships
WHERE year = 2016
GROUP BY container_type;']

["SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total_investment_in_healthcare_region
FROM investments
WHERE sector = 'Healthcare'
GROUP BY region;"]
["SELECT COUNT(*) AS donor_count\nFROM Donors \nWHERE region = 'South West';"]

['SELECT p.ProgramName, SUM(Donations.DonationAmount) AS Total_AmountDonated
FROM Programs p
JOIN DonorsPrograms dp ON p.ProgramID = dp.ProgramID
GROUP BY p.ProgramName;']
